page.content:
Campaign 2 party: Jester, Caleb, Fjord, Beau, Nott, Yasha, Caduceus.

How Mighty Nein connects

  • Work: Campaign 2 — The Mighty Nein are the player party of Campaign 2.
  • Character: Jester Lavorre — Jester Lavorre is the Traveler cleric of the Mighty Nein.
  • Character: Caleb Widogast — Caleb Widogast is the wizard of the Mighty Nein.
  • Character: Fjord — Fjord often captains the Mighty Nein on land and sea.

What is Mighty Nein?

The Mighty Nein are the misfit party of Campaign 2 — Jester, Fjord, Caleb, Beau, Nott, Yasha, Molly then Caduceus — who stumble from Trostenwald into a war and a god-plot.

Key threads lead to Campaign 2, Jester Lavorre, Caleb Widogast and Fjord.
